title: Bounce Pass Under Pressure
description: Partners work on a well-placed bounce pass with a passive defender stepping into the lane, learning when a bounce pass beats a chest pass.

content.objective: Choose and execute a bounce pass that beats a defender standing between the passers.
content.setup: Two passers face each other with a defender standing between them, hands up but not jumping to intercept.
instructions: The passer reads the defender's hands and decides between a chest pass or a bounce pass.
Bounce the ball roughly two-thirds of the way to the receiver.
The receiver meets the ball rather than waiting for it.
Rotate the defender every six passes.
coachingPoints: Bounce the pass low enough that the defender's hands can't reach it.
Push the pass firmly — a soft bounce pass gets picked off.
Receivers should step to the ball, not stand still.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the ball too close to the passer, giving the defender time to react.
Passing without first reading where the defender's hands are.
Passing from a standstill instead of stepping into it.
content.safety: The defender's hands stay up only — no lunging or swiping.
